items.title: Derrick Gardner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 9, 2013
items.q: And I’d always played a lot of swing gigs with him you know.

ctx.x: Irv Stokes. You might recognize that name. He played a lot with Lou Donaldson. And a fabulous trumpet player of that older generation. And I’d always played a lot of swing gigs with him you know. And he would just nail it to the wall. So we got to the jam session on Monday night and we were getting all modern playing “Footprints” and “Giant Steps” and all of this stuff, and all of these tunes, uptempo, and stuff like “Just in Time” and what’s another tune like proving ground tunes —
